location_address: San Diego San Diego, CA US
description:
Escape the city for a vibrant day along the Baja California coast with our Baja Lobster, Art & Surf Vibes Tour. This 8-hour journey blends colorful street art, local craftsmanship, beach time, and the iconic flavors of Baja-style lobster in the seaside village of Puerto Nuevo.

Discover murals, meet local artisans, enjoy laid-back beach vibes, and indulge in a delicious coastal meal—all in one unforgettable cross-border experience. Perfect for small groups, curious travelers, and anyone looking to experience Baja’s unique mix of surf culture, art, and culinary tradition.
what_is_included:
Private round-trip transportation from San Diego

Bilingual local guide

Guided art and culture walk in Rosarito

Visit to artisan markets

Stop at Puerto Nuevo Lobster Village

Free beach time in Rosarito
what_is_not_included:
Meals and drinks (Lobster lunch is paid separately)

Gratuities for guide and driver

Personal expenses

Valid passport (required for border crossing)
itinerary:
9:00 AM – Pick-Up in San Diego
Meet your bilingual guide and begin the scenic drive to Rosarito.

10:30 AM – Arrival in Rosarito
Enjoy a guided walk through colorful street murals and local art spaces.

11:30 AM – Artisan Market Visit
Explore handmade crafts and meet talented local vendors.

12:30 PM – Beach Time
Relax on the beach, soak up the sun, or enjoy a drink by the shore.

2:00 PM – Puerto Nuevo Lobster Village
Visit the seaside village and enjoy an optional lobster lunch with ocean views (meal not included).

3:30 PM – Return Journey
Depart Puerto Nuevo and head back to the U.S. via the Fast Pass lane for aditional fee of $85.

5:00 PM – Drop-Off in San Diego
highlights:
Cross the border seamlessly with private round-trip transportation from San Diego

Explore Rosarito’s street murals and urban art installations

Visit artisan markets and meet local craftsmen

Relax with free time on Rosarito’s beach

Visit Puerto Nuevo, the famous lobster village

Optional lobster lunch at a local seaside restaurant (not included)
